# Mission Canvas

> Customized Software as a Service. Mission Canvas builds software around your business workflows, then maintains and improves it as your work changes.

Mission Canvas offers Customized Software as a Service: software built around a business workflow, with scoped maintenance and agreed improvements. A reusable foundation supports source-linked work, version history and controlled actions. Each engagement defines its workflow, costs, deployment and care responsibilities. Start a workflow conversation: https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/


## Main pages

- [Mission Canvas — Custom software, continuously cared for](https://pretendhome.github.io/): Customized Software as a Service. Mission Canvas builds software around your business workflows, then maintains and improves it as your work changes.
- [Find your first workflow](https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/): Tell Mission Canvas about one recurring workflow. We’ll explore a focused custom software project and the ongoing care it would need.
- [Workflows by industry](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/): Explore illustrative workflows by industry, then use them to describe the information, people, and decisions your own software needs to support.
- [Questions and answers](https://pretendhome.github.io/faq): These answers describe our proposed CSaaS approach; your written proposal sets the scope, responsibilities, price, and operating terms for an engagement.
- [How it works](https://pretendhome.github.io/how-it-works): We shape a focused software project around your workflow, then agree how its maintenance and improvement will be handled.
- [Palette](https://pretendhome.github.io/palette): Palette is a desktop foundation and development application associated with Mission Canvas, with its own capabilities, installation requirements, and operating boundaries.
- [Pricing](https://pretendhome.github.io/pricing): Our proposed service combines a scoped setup and build with recurring care, with final terms and figures set by quote.
- [Security and control](https://pretendhome.github.io/security): Security requirements belong in the project scope, alongside the workflow, integrations, responsibilities, and evidence needed before everyday use begins.

## Industries

- [Construction workflows](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/construction): A custom construction workflow could connect selected project records, open questions, and handover tasks, with ongoing care defined for the solution.
- [Education workflows](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/education): A custom education workflow could bring requests, required information, and reviewed communications together, with access and ongoing care shaped around your setting.
- [Events and venue workflows](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/events-venues): A custom venue workflow could connect incoming inquiries, event requirements, selected availability information, and reviewed proposals, with ongoing care agreed for the solution.
- [Healthcare administration workflows](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/healthcare): A possible healthcare administration engagement would begin with the information, access, professional responsibilities, and review required before considering a custom software solution.
- [Logistics workflows](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/logistics): A custom logistics workflow could connect selected shipment information, exception ownership, and customer updates, with ongoing care agreed around the operation.
- [Office workflows](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/office): A custom office workflow could connect requests, selected documents, responsible owners, and reviewed responses, with ongoing care defined around the team's needs.
- [Front desk workflows](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/voice-front-desk): A custom front desk workflow could help staff capture requests, find approved information, and coordinate follow-up, with voice considered where it proves useful.
